ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Power Loss: Zod loses his powers under a red sun, like that of Krypton, and other effects draining or interfering with the energies of the yellow sun can deprive him of his powers. Without his powers, Dru-Zod has Strength 2 and Stamina 3. Vulnerability: Zod is as vulnerable to magic as anyone else. His Toughness is not Impervious against magical attacks. Weakness: Kryptonite (see sidebar).
